feeds.title: Pat's Adventures in Dialysis
feeds.description: I retired in July 2012 and by November 2012 I had end stage kidney disease. I was Ill for at least 18 months before I had to be rushed to the hospital. I'm telling my tale in the hopes that what happened to me can be prevented by others.

feeds.title: Dialysis Dietitian Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Maria Tointon, RDN, CSR. I am an experienced Registered Dietitian Nutritionist who has specialized in kidney disease for over 19 years. Our understanding of your nutrition needs on dialysis has evolved over the years -especially recently with a more plant-based focus. As a Certified Specialist in Renal Nutrition, I continue to work at local dialysis centers providing ongoing education & support. My goal is to reach more people & have a larger impact. Stay connected for monthly blog posts with informative information!
